'''2003 France National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship at Espace Chambon in Cusset (3 May 2003). [[Richard Andichon]] was the qualifier.<ref name="pc-intl03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040621085705/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Nationals and Provincials (International Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 21 June 2004.</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Cusset, France
* '''Dates:''' 3 May 2003<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Venue:''' Espace Chambon, Cusset<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Time:''' 11am<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Fee:''' 10 euros<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Benoit Morel]]<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Qualifier:''' [[Richard Andichon]]<ref name="pc-intl03" />
